findings.summary: The new ContactRecord invariant forbids private notes in exports, while the export operation effects and journey step x4 now require each exported contact to include its private notes.
findings.evidence: invariants: '- Private notes are never included in an export' vs effects: [Export authorized records, Each exported contact includes its private notes, ...] and x4 action: 'Export authorized records of the authenticated owner only, with each contact's private notes'
